method: GmG classifies the 2M-spot typing subsample; mixed = GmG mixture flag; genus_mismatch = the selected genus is neither GmG call nor among its top hits; borderline = second genus >= 5 hashes and concentration >= 0.7, rescreened at 6M spots
detection_limit: a second genus at about 2% of pairs at 2M spots, 0.5% at 6M (spike-in, MATPredict results/2026-11-02_contam_spikein/NOTE.md); no signal for a same-genus mixture
notes: flagged runs only (ok runs not recorded); runs stay typed in MATPredict; some genus_mismatch rows are genus naming within one family (Beauveria called Cordyceps), not a wrong organism
